notes:
Wyrm 2.0.0 is the biggest update I've ever made.

Global chat now lives right inside the arena. You can see who's on Wyrm and which arena they're playing in. Snakey Rain is built into the app, and you can design your own snake bead by bead in Skin Studio. On top of that, your on-screen buttons can be as big and colourful as you want, the bot plays like NTL's again, and a lot of things got faster and smoother.

Thank you for every report you sent. Honestly, they made this update.

## What's new

- **Arena chat with three tabs: TEAM, GLOBAL and ONLINE.** Read and reply to Wyrm's global chat without leaving your match. Each tab has its own unread count, and when the chat is folded the button shows both added up. The X closes it in one tap.
- **See who's online.** The ONLINE tab lists everyone who's been on Wyrm lately, with their in-game name, their username and the arena they're playing in. It has a scroll bar so you always know where you are in the list. If you turn off *Show my activity to friends*, you won't appear in it.
- **Snakey Rain, built in.** It has its own page with Characters, Settings and Login. There's an on-screen key you can place anywhere, and a panel in the arena you can move, resize and recolour.
- **Skin Studio.** Build your snake bead by bead: finishes, colours, painting, even the eyes.
- **Saved skins.** Every custom skin you play with is kept automatically. Tap one to wear it again.
- **Wyrm skins.** 23 creatures and 15 strip looks, with a live moving preview.
- **Your buttons, your way.** On-screen buttons can be up to 5x bigger, with their own label, border and fill colours. A button that's switched on gets a green border, so you always know.
- **More control over the layout.** Leaderboard width and height, stats text colour, and Spine for just you or for everyone.
- **Play in the background.** The game keeps running when you switch apps.
- **Joystick knob mode.** The knob can go back to the centre when you let go.
- **Tags fly off** a snake when it dies.
- **Any in-game name you like.** Many players can share the same name, and you can change it whenever you want. It updates everywhere, from chat to the leaderboards. Clear it and your username shows instead.
- **Delete your own messages** in global chat and in DMs. Just touch and hold.
- **Profile photos** now have a proper cropper, and they load much faster.
- **IPv6 arenas** work now.

## Changed

- The bot plays exactly like NTL's bot again.
- Boost reacts faster, and ping is measured more accurately.
- On-screen keys are white by default.
- Your own row in the leaderboards is light green, and ranks past 99 fit properly.

## Fixed

- The game freezing while you touched or scrolled the Snakey Rain panel.
- Stutter when there are a lot of snakes on screen.
- Teammates disappearing from the minimap after every death.
- A short freeze when joining an arena.
- Snakey Rain disconnecting when your snake died.

Install it the same way as before, with AltStore, SideStore, KSign or ESign. Your settings, skins and layouts are saved to your Wyrm account, so updating won't lose anything.
